impact_narrative: All TLS clients hitting checkout ingress are failing handshakes, blocking roughly 1,200 purchase attempts per minute.
cause_summary: No recent commit plausibly explains this — the certificate itself has expired ('certificate has expired' in client errors), which is an infrastructure expiry, not a code change.

runbook_citation.heading_path: TLS Certificate Runbook > Expired certificate on ingress
runbook_citation.why: Walks through renewing and rotating the ingress certificate immediately.

next_steps: Renew the ingress certificate now (runbook has the cert-manager and manual paths).
Verify handshake success with openssl s_client against the ingress.
Add a 21-day expiry alert on certificate lifetimes.
